title: Tutorial 109: Metal on macOS - CNA Tutorials

Covers what CNA_DEVICES=OFF actually leaves behind, how to write one codebase that compiles both ways, which platform service each of the ten classes goes through and how far it reaches on each platform, its failure contract, and how to test it without opening a real dialog.

title: Tutorial 12: Moving Sprites and Basic Animation — CNA Tutorials
